name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the Budapest University of Technology and Economics, a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion that redirected his career path. He initially volunteered as a data analyst, quickly proving his aptitude for understanding vehicle dynamics and driver feedback.

His analytical skills and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights propelled him into the role of test driver coordinator. At AF Corse, Zoltán excels at optimizing testing schedules, matching drivers to specific development programs, and ensuring seamless communication between the engineering and driving teams. He has a knack for identifying subtle performance improvements often overlooked, making him a valuable asset in refining the car's setup.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of strong black coffee before any major testing session.
